title: Trombonists Cornish, Frankie Dusen and Buddy Johnson
summary: Asked about Big Cornish, he recalls playing with Frankie Dusen and mentions trombonist Buddy Johnson, then says he worked with Bunk Johnson.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: What about Big Cornie? Did you ever work with him?
Big Cornish. You know the trombone player? No. No. I don't work with him. Willie Cornish? What about Frankie Deucon?

I used to play Frankie Deucon there once in a while. He played slide and trombone with Frankie Deucon. Tall, slender, dog, fall, black, cut of hair. He lived across the river. Frankie Deucon. Buddy Johnson lived across the river too. Because you know of him, trombone player. Buddy Johnson. He lived across the river. A little short for him.
Did you ever work with Buddy or Yanks or any of those guys?
No. I used to work with another, with Bunk Johnson. You heard talk of Bunk?
